review.assessment: This change introduces a new `src/lib.rs` containing only stub implementations of `rle_encode` and `rle_decode`. Both functions are hardcoded to return empty strings (`String::new()`) and contain no actual run-length encoding or decoding logic. As a result, the acceptance suite fails immediately because the functions do not process their inputs correctly.

findings.actual: Both tests fail assertion errors because the functions return `""`.
findings.defect: Stub implementations returning empty strings instead of performing RLE logic.
findings.expected: Tests pass, with `rle_encode("aaabb")` returning `"a3b2"` and `rle_decode("a3b2")` returning `"aaabb"`.
